entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: A small, destitute, drunken songmage of Sumifa with an enormous nose who helped Cheyne banish the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City where Ogwater lived and met Cheyne.

entities.name: Cheyne
entities.description: Young man whose life Ogwater saved and who recruited him for the Chimes.

entities.name: Saelin
entities.description: Assassin of Riolla Hifrata who tried to decapitate Cheyne for his totem.

entities.name: Riolla Hifrata
entities.description: Crime boss, Ogwater's former lover, who gave him the black gemstone.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Creature sleeping beneath Mount Sarraza in the Chimes, released and banished by Ogwater.

entities.name: Chimes
entities.description: Place beneath Mount Sarraza where the Beast of the Hours lay sleeping.

entities.name: Mount Sarraza
entities.description: Mountain above where the Beast of the Hours slept.

entities.name: Rotapan
entities.description: Orc in Wyrvil who gave Ogwater the red gemstone.

entities.name: Wiggulf
entities.description: Selkie chieftain who gave Ogwater the blue gemstone.

entities.name: Luquin
entities.description: Elven healer who gave Ogwater the white gemstone.

entities.name: Samor the Collector
entities.description: Owner of the chronoclave whose music Ogwater played.

events.summary: In 3050 AR, Saelin tries to decapitate Cheyne for his totem; Ogwater trips Cheyne, saving his life, and hides him on a rooftop.
events.quote: Ogwater tripped Cheyne up, saving his life, and hid him on a rooftop.

events.summary: Ogwater and Cheyne knock out the assassin; Ogwater picks Cheyne's pocket then shows him secret passages through the city walls.
events.quote: Then they assaulted the assassin together, knocking him out.

events.summary: Cheyne recruits Ogwater for a trip to the Chimes where the Beast of the Hours sleeps.
events.quote: Cheyne later recruited Og to join him on a trip to the Chimes

events.summary: Ogwater collects four magical gemstones from Rotapan, Wiggulf, Luquin and Riolla Hifrata.
events.quote: Ogwater collected his four magical gemstones

events.summary: Ogwater releases the Beast of the Hours and banishes it.
events.quote: Ogwater released the Beast of the Hours and banished it.
